standards_sources.title: Primary Language Curriculum / Curaclam Teanga na Bunscoile (2019), English L1 learning outcomes, Stages 1–4
standards_sources.note: Strands = Oral Language, Reading, Writing; elements = Communicating, Understanding, Exploring and using. LO numbers follow the LO tables (Oral Language LO1–12, Reading LO1–10, Writing LO1–9). Many LOs span two stages.

standards_sources.title: Primary Mathematics Curriculum (2023), learning outcomes by strand unit and stage
standards_sources.note: Strands: Algebra; Data and chance; Measures; Number; Shape and space. Learning outcomes have no numeric codes, so strand unit + stage are given. Process elements: Understanding and connecting; Communicating; Reasoning; Applying and problem-solving.

standards_sources.title: PMC Toolkit progression continuum – Measures: Time
Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM) Education Specification for Primary and Special Schools (NCCA, 2025) – Science, Technology and Engineering (STE) Education specification
standards_sources.note: Confirmed strands: Nature of STEM; Living things; Materials; Energy and forces; Technology; Engineering. Elements: Exploring and understanding; Creative and critical thinking; Applying and problem-solving; Evaluating and communicating. LOs are uncoded, so the LO text is quoted.

standards_sources.title: NCCA – FAQ about the Science, Technology and Engineering Education (STE) Specification
standards_sources.note: Energy forms by stage: Stage 1 magnetism, Stage 2 sound, Stage 3 light, Stage 4 electricity; heat in Materials at Stage 3. Environment/sustainability topics moved to the Social and Environmental Education (SEE) specification.

standards_sources.title: Department of Education and Youth Circular 0067/2025 – Primary Curriculum for primary and special schools (dated 22 September 2025)
standards_sources.note: Confirms the five specifications, including STEM Education (STE + PMC). Schools phase new areas in from 2026/27; all areas fully in place by 2031/32, so many schools still teach the 1999 Science curriculum.

standards_sources.title: Primary School Curriculum: Science (SESE), 1999

The national curriculum in England: key stages 1 and 2 framework document (English, mathematics, science programmes of study)

standards_sources.note: Reception (age 4–5) is not covered by the 2014 national curriculum; early skills are mapped to the EYFS Early Learning Goals (ELGs).

Council of Europe – CEFR Companion volume (2020)
standards_sources.note: rm.coe.int refused automated access (HTTP 403); descriptors were read from the web.archive.org copy of this PDF. CEFR describes additional-language proficiency, so levels for first-language/dyslexic learners are an approximate equivalence. Phonics and phonological-awareness skills have no CEFR scale; those are marked in 'scale'.

standards_sources.title: Council Recommendation of 22 May 2018 on key competences for lifelong learning (2018/C 189/01)
standards_sources.note: Read via the web.archive.org copy of the EUR-Lex PDF (EUR-Lex returned an empty response to automated access). Key competence 3: 'Mathematical competence and competence in science, technology, engineering'.

QQI Draft Award Standards – Mathematical and Numerical Core Competence, NFQ Levels 1–4 (February 2024)

College and Career Readiness Standards for Adult Education (Pimentel, US Department of Education, April 2013)
standards_sources.note: lincs.ed.gov refused automated access (403); read via the web.archive.org copy. Levels: A = K–1, B = 2–3, C = 4–5, D = 6–8, E = 9–12 (maths: C = 4–5 + part of 6, D = part of 6 + 7–8). CCRS is a selection; where a CCSS standard used here is not among the CCRS selections the note says so and the level is the grade-equivalent band.

skills.subject: english

eu.scale: Overall oral comprehension: recognise everyday, familiar words delivered clearly and slowly

skills.subject: maths
skills.name: Using equal groups and times tables

skills.subject: maths

skills.subject: maths
skills.name: Measuring with units
skills.objective: Compare and calculate lengths, masses and capacities with units.

skills.subject: maths
skills.name: Reading pictographs
skills.objective: Read and compare information in a simple pictograph.

eu.keyCompetence: Mathematical competence – numbers, measures and structures, basic operations (2018 Key competence 3A)

skills.subject: maths

skills.subject: maths
skills.name: Reasoning with numbers
